Some Background on the situation

Let me start this off by saying I have a lot of respect for @AnarchoHeathen and his mod crew. They've done a lot of good things on Reddit, and for the community in general. A subverse transfer was not my first choice. I originally tried to contact his mod team, and see if there was anything I could do to help with the subverse. After all, I knew they were busy with Reddit, and their podcast. However, after some failed attempts at getting a response, through comments and messages, I talked to a couple of the active members I have seen. And, they agreed that it was time for a change. While we respect the old crew, they were just too busy to be active, and nurture this subverse. That's ok. Life happens. So, about 11 days ago I put in this subeverse request. This required a lot of thought for me. But, in the end I decided we needed active Voat members moderating this sub. So, I made the request.

So. what's going to be different now?

Not much will change in the way this subverse funtions. We will still have mostly the same "rules", which will be posted again soon, and most of your daily activity here will have the same idea as far as flow. But, what you will see that is different is this:

  • The CCP limit to downvoat has been removed. This is helpful in preventing the v/all downvoat squad from hitting us, but we feel it hinders this subverse, and it's growth. By putting a CCP restriction in place we are completely removed from v/all and people who are specifically looking for this sub. Which, is harder than it sounds. Plus, it removes your ability to downvoat spam, and bad information. We want the community to be able to help this subverse grow, remain active, and have a say in what is moderated.

  • We're gonna spruce things up around here. the CSS is default, and that's fine, but, why not make this subverse ours. We don't have CSS experts on staff here, but we have more that enough resources to make things work, and to claim this subverse for us.

  • There will be more transparency. The modlogs will be linked to in the sidebar, the rules and guidelines for all moderators will also be there. v/Asatru may not be your home kindred, but we want it to be a part of a community driven, active Greater Tribe for everyone that visits. We want you to know what is happening at all times, and to have a say.

  • Finally, you will see more active moderators. This is one of the rules for the moderation staff. If you cannot be an active part of the community you will not be able to function as a moderator. Moderators are here to keep things clean, on-topic, and to help nurture and build the community.

What now?

Well, we are part of v/all, and we are going to be working hard to grow this subverse into something beautiful. We really hope you embrace this, and help us to make this happen. Again, we want this to be a community driven subverse. This is an online Greater Tribe, and we really hope you all take this head on with us!

We've already gained a few subscribers, and seen new activity. I'm really glad you are onboard!
